NAME: Memories and boot verification plan
details: Blocks 3, 4, 5: isram_top, bootrom_top, dsram_top, the ILOCK control and the boot ROM program. Source: GARUDA-MEM-SPEC-001 and the map in garuda_system.yaml. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. The boot path has no recovery on silicon if it is wrong, so its failure paths are P1.

NAME: A The three memories as bus slaves
F01 ISRAM is 64 KiB readable and writable word by word
details: From the data port and from the debugger. Requirements R-1, R-2.
implementation_note: Method: sim (AHB master agent, scoreboard with a memory model). Today: tb_mem ISRAM write then read; random soak 4 x 200

NAME: sb_mem
details: Every read compared with a memory model that mirrors every accepted write.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_mem.cp_isram_addr
details: First word, last word, and each quarter of the range.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F02 DSRAM is 64 KiB and contiguous across its four banks
details: One slave, four 16 KiB macros selected by address bits 15:14. Only the selected bank is written. Requirement R-5, spec [N-7.11] to [N-7.13].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_mem t_dsram_contiguous

NAME: a_bank_onehot
details: At most one bank write enable is active.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/mem/mem_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_mem.cp_dsram_boundary
details: Back-to-back accesses across each of the three bank boundaries, in both directions.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_mem
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F03 Boot ROM is 4 KiB and read-only
details: Every word readable, including byte and halfword reads; a write gives an error and changes nothing. Requirement R-4, spec [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_mem t_rom_read

NAME: a_rom_write_error
details: A write transfer to the ROM returns the two-cycle ERROR.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/mem/mem_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: sb_mem
details: Read data compared with the ROM image file.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F04 Byte enables for the seven legal size and offset combinations
details: Word at 0, halfword at 0 and 2, byte at 0 to 3; the other bytes of the word are untouched on a write. Spec [N-7.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_mem t_mem_sizes

NAME: cg_mem.x_size_offset_mem
details: The seven combinations, read and written, on each of the three memories.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_mem
details: Model compare per byte.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F05 A misaligned transfer gets an error
details: Word with address bits 1:0 not 0 and halfword with bit 0 set. The core never issues one; the slave answers ERROR as a backstop. Spec [N-7.4].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: no check.

NAME: a_misaligned_error
details: A misaligned transfer returns ERROR and writes nothing.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/mem/mem_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_mem.cp_misaligned
details: Each misaligned combination on each memory.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F06 Addresses above the size alias down
details: Inside the 256 MiB region the high address bits are ignored. Spec [N-7.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_mem [N-7.2] aliasing

NAME: sb_mem
details: The model aliases the same way.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F07 Zero wait states
details: hreadyout is high in every cycle and read data arrives in the data phase, with back-to-back transfers of any mix. Requirement R-6, spec [N-7.6].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_mem t_zero_wait

NAME: a_hready_high
details: hreadyout_o is 1 except in the first cycle of an ERROR.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/mem/mem_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_mem.cp_b2b
details: Read after write to the same address, write after read, and runs of 8 with no idle cycle.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F08 Bus protocol on each slave
details: Idle and busy transfers are ignored, an unselected slave does nothing, and an ERROR is exactly two cycles.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: AHB protocol checker bound in tb_mem

NAME: ahb_checker
details: AHB-Lite protocol checker - 0 violations.
implementation_note: tb/ahb/ahb_lite_checker.v.

NAME: a_unselected_no_write
details: No write enable without hsel in the address phase.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/mem/mem_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F09 Memory contents are not reset
details: The arrays keep their contents across a reset; nothing in the RTL depends on them being zero. Spec [N-7.15].
implementation_note: Method: sim with X-propagation. Today: sw/chip watchdog test checks DSRAM survives; X-propagation passes on the 8 chip tests

NAME: xprop chip tests
details: All eight chip programs with uninitialised memories.
implementation_note: Run 2026-10-04, all pass.

NAME: B The ISRAM write lock
details: Spec 6.1, 7.4. Requirement R-3.

NAME: F10 ILOCK is write-1-to-set and cannot be cleared by software
details: MEMCTL bit 0. Only a reset clears it. Spec [N-6.1], [N-9.2]. The register sits in the reset controller's window; this specification still says window 8 offset 0x20 and needs correcting.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model) + formal. Today: tb_crg - not cleared by writing 0, cleared by SWRST

NAME: a_ilock_sticky
details: Once set the lock stays set until hreset.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/mem/mem_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_ilock.cp_clear_by
details: Lock cleared by each of the four reset sources.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F11 A write to locked ISRAM gets an error and changes nothing
details: Two-cycle ERROR, the macro is not written, and reads are unaffected. Spec [N-7.8], [N-7.10].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_mem t_ilock

NAME: a_locked_no_write
details: No ISRAM write enable while the lock is set and the master is not the debugger.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/mem/mem_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_ilock.x_lock_master_dir
details: Locked and unlocked, debugger and other master, read and write.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F12 The debugger can write locked ISRAM
details: The interconnect's indication that the granted master is SBA bypasses the lock. Spec [N-7.9].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_mem t_isram_sba_write; tb_debug

NAME: a_sba_bypass
details: With the indication high a write lands whatever the lock.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/mem/mem_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F13 The indication lines up with the transfer it belongs to
details: It must be the data-phase master's, not the address-phase master's, when masters change back to back.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_ilock.cp_master_switch
details: A locked-out write from the data port directly before and directly after a debugger write.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: a_locked_no_write
details: Covered by F11.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/mem/mem_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: C Boot
details: Spec section 8. Checked at chip level with the boot ROM program and the flash model.

NAME: F14 A good image boots
details: Magic checked, text copied to ISRAM, data copied to DSRAM, both CRCs verified, ILOCK set, jump to the entry point. Requirements R-7, R-8, R-9.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: make test_chip_flash; every chip test enters through the ROM

NAME: t_chip_flash
details: A 700-byte image from the flash model.
implementation_note: Passing.

NAME: cg_boot.cp_image
details: Text length 4 bytes, mid, 64 KiB; data length 0, 4 bytes, mid; entry at the base and elsewhere.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F15 A corrupted image is caught
details: A single bit flipped anywhere in the text or the data image fails the CRC and takes the recovery path. Requirement R-9.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: no test

NAME: t_chip_boot_crc_fail
details: One flipped bit in the text image, then in the data image, then in each header field.
implementation_note: sw/chip + flash model with a corruption option. Planned.

NAME: F16 Recovery leaves the chip loadable over JTAG
details: After a failure - ILOCK clear, RSTREASON.BOOTFAIL set, the core spinning in the ROM, and a debugger load followed by a release runs. Requirement R-10, spec [N-8.4].
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: no test

NAME: t_chip_boot_recovery
details: CRC failure, then load over SBA, then run.
implementation_note: sw/chip + JTAG mode. Planned.

NAME: F17 An erased flash takes the recovery path
details: Magic reads 0xFFFFFFFF. Spec [N-8.1].
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: no test

NAME: t_chip_boot_blank
details: Flash model returning all ones.
implementation_note: Planned.

NAME: F18 Header values the ROM must refuse
details: Text length above 64 KiB or not word aligned, data length not word aligned, entry point outside ISRAM, non-zero reserved words. The specification states the limits; what the ROM does with each has to be checked against sw/bootrom and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: no test

NAME: t_chip_boot_bad_header
details: One illegal value per field.
implementation_note: Planned.

NAME: F19 boot_sel selects JTAG load
details: With the pin at 1 the flash is not touched and the ROM waits for the debugger. Requirement R-11.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: sw/chip basic, IRQ, WDT and JTAG tests enter this way

NAME: t_chip_jtag
details: Load and run with boot_sel 1.
implementation_note: Passing.

NAME: F20 An exception during boot reaches recovery
details: A bus error or illegal instruction inside the ROM program must not hang or jump into unloaded memory.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: no test

NAME: t_chip_boot_trap
details: A flash model that stops answering mid image, and a ROM access fault.
implementation_note: Planned.

NAME: F21 The flash never answers
details: A missing or stuck flash - the SPI master reads zeros or the engine never finishes. The ROM's poll loops must have an exit. Not stated in the specification; to be checked against sw/bootrom and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: no test

NAME: t_chip_boot_no_flash
details: MISO held low, MISO held high, and chip select ignored.
implementation_note: Planned.

NAME: F22 CRC-32 is the IEEE 802.3 one
details: Polynomial 0x04C11DB7, reflected, initial and final all ones. The ROM and tools/mkbootimg.py must agree. Spec [N-8.8].
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: t_chip_flash passes with an image built by the tool

NAME: crc_vectors
details: The ROM routine against known CRC vectors, run on the core.
implementation_note: sw/tests. Planned.

NAME: F23 ILOCK is set before the jump
details: Firmware starts with instruction memory already locked. Spec 8.2 step 10.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level + formal. Today: sw/chip/t_chip_basic.c checks a write to ISRAM faults

NAME: a_locked_at_entry
details: The first fetch from ISRAM after a flash boot happens with the lock set.
implementation_note: Bound assertion at the chip top. Planned.

NAME: F24 Boot time
details: About 4.1 us per word at the boot clock divider; 67 ms for a full image. Spec [N-8.6a].
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level (measurement). Today: measured 1.12 ms for 700 bytes

NAME: t_chip_flash
details: Time to entry recorded.
implementation_note: Passing.

NAME: D With the rest of the chip
details: Checked at chip level and by connectivity checks.

NAME: F25 Each master reaches the memories it is allowed
details: Instruction port to ISRAM and ROM, data port to all three, debugger to all three, DMA to DSRAM only.
implementation_note: Method: sim + connectivity. Today: tb_ahb_interconnect; tb_dma_top [R-9]

NAME: conn_reach
details: Cross reference to the interconnect plan.
implementation_note: Planned.

NAME: F26 Instructions execute from ISRAM and from the ROM
details: Fetches through the real interconnect, including a fetch from an address just written.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level. Today: every chip test

NAME: t_chip_basic
details: Runs from ISRAM after entering through the ROM.
implementation_note: Passing.

details: Spec section 9.

details: Spec [N-9.1].

NAME: hal_cdc

implementation_note: flow/2_static.
